cuts.reason: Open with the question and name the three quantities; establish the type system and light field.
First anchor: make one million seconds concrete as a number the viewer can hold.
The pivot: put million beside billion so the 1,000x gap is seen, not stated.
Complete the pattern: three cells at once make the x1000 ladder legible; the trillion cell lands the piece.
Land the takeaway in the fewest possible words and let it rest.
